title: Pope Leo Spends Peaceful Night in Hospital; Vatican Confirms Stable Recovery After Lung Surgery
detail: Pope Leo spent a peaceful night in hospital following lung cancer surgery, with the Vatican confirming his recovery is progressing stably after the removal of a malignant nodule from his lung. The Holy See's press office issued an update describing his condition as stable, offering reassurance to 1.4 billion Catholics worldwide closely monitoring his recovery.

title: King Charles Sends Letter to Pope Leo Expressing Support After Lung Cancer Diagnosis
detail: King Charles sent a personal letter to Pope Leo expressing support and solidarity following the Pope's lung cancer diagnosis and surgery. The gesture from the British monarch reflects the broad international response to the Vatican's disclosure that a malignant nodule was removed from Pope Leo's lung, with world leaders and heads of state reaching out to the Holy See.
